# CI/CD Integration Patterns

Dimension covering how to integrate cyclomatic complexity checking into
continuous integration pipelines, pre-commit hooks, and development workflows.

Sources: see [citations.md](../citations.md) for full details.

## Integration Patterns

Three patterns for complexity enforcement in CI/CD:

| Pattern | What It Does | Tools |
|---------|-------------|-------|
| **Hard gate** | Block merges when threshold exceeded | xenon, ruff, flake8+mccabe |
| **Warning/reporting** | Report violations without blocking | radon, wily report |
| **Trend monitoring** | Detect complexity regressions over time | wily diff |

## Pre-commit Hooks

### Xenon (via pre-commit-xenon)

The most purpose-built pre-commit hook for complexity gating [12]:

```yaml
# .pre-commit-config.yaml
- repo: https://github.com/yunojuno/pre-commit-xenon
  rev: cc59b0431a5d072786b59430e9b342b2881064f6
  hooks:
  - id: xenon
    args: ["--max-average=A", "--max-modules=C", "--max-absolute=C"]
```

Three threshold dimensions [11][12]:
- `--max-average`: Average CC across all functions (A = keep average at 1-5)
- `--max-modules`: Per-module CC limit (C = up to 20)
- `--max-absolute`: Per-function CC limit (C = up to 20)

Error output: `ERROR:xenon:block "tests/test_views.py:76 test_get_list" has a
rank of D` [12]

### Ruff (C901 rule)

Ruff is the fastest option for pre-commit CC checking [15][16]:

```yaml
# .pre-commit-config.yaml
- repo: https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff-pre-commit
  rev: v0.x.x
  hooks:
  - id: ruff
    args: ["--select=C901"]
```

Configuration in pyproject.toml [16]:

```toml
[tool.ruff.lint]
select = ["C901"]

[tool.ruff.lint.mccabe]
max-complexity = 10
```

**Note**: C901 is not enabled by default in ruff — must be explicitly added to
the select list [16].

### Flake8 + mccabe

Traditional approach [8]:

```ini
# setup.cfg or .flake8
[flake8]
max-complexity = 10
```

Or via command line: `flake8 --max-complexity=10` [8]

## CI Pipeline Integration

### Linting (Gate Pattern)

Run complexity checks as a CI step. Any of these tools exit non-zero on
violation:

```bash
# Option 1: Ruff (fastest)
ruff check --select=C901 src/

# Option 2: Flake8 + mccabe
flake8 --max-complexity=10 src/

# Option 3: Xenon (multi-dimensional thresholds)
xenon --max-absolute=B --max-modules=B --max-average=A src/
```

Xenon is unique in supporting simultaneous per-function, per-module, and
average thresholds — the others only support a single global threshold [11].

### Trend Monitoring (Wily)

Wily detects complexity regressions by comparing against git history [14]:

```bash
# Build metrics cache for the last 50 commits
wily build src/

# Compare current state against previous commit
wily diff src/ -r HEAD^1

# Rank files by complexity
wily rank src/ -m cyclomatic.complexity
```

CI integration: run `wily build src/ && wily diff src/ -r HEAD^1` in CI to
detect complexity increases in each PR [14].

### Reporting (Radon)

Generate complexity reports without blocking [9]:

```bash
# Show all functions with CC grade C or worse
radon cc src/ -a -nc

# Show average complexity
radon cc src/ -a -s
```

Radon integrates with cloud CI platforms: Codacy, Code Climate, coala,
CodeFactor [9].

## Cognitive Complexity in CI

### complexipy

Active, Rust-based tool with native CI support [21]:

```bash
# Analyze and fail if threshold exceeded
complexipy . --max-complexity-allowed 15

# Compare against git ref
complexipy . --diff HEAD~1

# Export for CI artifacts
complexipy . --output-json --output-csv
```

GitHub Actions: `complexipy-action@v2` [21].
SARIF output for GitHub Code Scanning integration [21].

## Recommended CI Configuration

For a Python project using modern tooling:

```toml
# pyproject.toml

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = [
    "E",    # pycodestyle errors
    "F",    # pyflakes
    "C901", # McCabe complexity
]

[tool.ruff.lint.mccabe]
max-complexity = 10
```

```yaml
# .pre-commit-config.yaml
repos:
  - repo: https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff-pre-commit
    rev: v0.x.x
    hooks:
      - id: ruff
  - repo: https://github.com/yunojuno/pre-commit-xenon
    rev: <commit-sha>
    hooks:
      - id: xenon
        args: ["--max-average=A", "--max-modules=B", "--max-absolute=B"]
```

## Deprecated/Unmaintained Tools

- **pytest-mccabe**: Maintainer ceased active use in 2016. Recommends
  pytest-flake8 or tox + flake8 as alternatives [28].
- **flake8-cognitive-complexity**: Last release August 2020. Tested only on
  Python 3.7.x [20].
